turns.prompt_text: on an Android game would it be possible for me to skip and add
turns.response_html:
It is difficult to quickly skip most video ads in Android games, as they are designed to be unskippable for a certain duration.

You have a few options to remove or avoid ads:

  • Go Offline: For games that allow offline play, enable Airplane Mode or disconnect Wi-Fi/data to prevent ads from loading.
  • Use a Private DNS: Set your Android's Private DNS to an ad-blocking provider like dns.adguard.com (found in Settings -> Network & internet -> Private DNS). This blocks many ads system-wide.
  • Re-launch the App: Sometimes hitting the Home button and immediately relaunching the game will bypass an ad before it starts.
  • Purchase the Ad-Free Version: The developer often offers a small purchase to permanently remove all ads and support the game.
